- `EpicDetail.tsx:9` imports it and renders it at `EpicDetail.tsx:686`.
- The old single-line "queued · position N" text at `EpicDetail.tsx:662` was correctly narrowed (`!(chat && chat.queuedPosition > 0)`) so it no longer duplicates/competes with the new panel.
- The PRD file itself moved from the active queue into `session-manager-operations/scheduler/epics/psess-msaj29wk-6/prds-archived/898-visible-prompt-queue-panel-for-epic-chat.md` and no longer appears in `queue.json` — consistent with a completed, archived job.
